cavity_and_continuum.fixed_source_energy_reference: SPICE MBIS point q/p through the identical pyddx ddPCM equation
cavity_and_continuum.radii: MAPLE SMD-water Coulomb radii per element

no_training_contract.mdp_role: unchanged official public total charge, molecular dipole, and polarizability information; latent atomwise q/p retained only as a baseline
no_training_contract.polar_role: unchanged official zero-field atomwise q/p topology and field-induced source increment
no_training_contract.primary_source: minimum-Coulomb-change projection of MACE-POLAR zero-field q/p to MACE-MDP total charge and molecular dipole
no_training_contract.selection_rule: all six candidates and all numerical gates were frozen before reading any candidate cavity-MEP or fixed-source ddPCM energy result

source_kernels.gaussian: normalized 1.5-A MACE-POLAR monopole/dipole Gaussian density in first radial channel

prelock_activity_disclosure.geometry_only_smoke: record 0 model outputs and Gaussian-metric condition numbers were evaluated to establish executable feasibility; no MBIS labels, MEP, ddPCM energy, or solvation target was read
prelock_activity_disclosure.post_training_result_known: the earlier failed q/p head and its frozen 60-case result predate this experiment and are context, not candidate selection data

projection.constraint: exact total charge and Cartesian molecular dipole sum_A(q_A R_A + p_A)
projection.metric: full analytic Coulomb Gram of equal-width normalized Gaussian monopole/dipole correction densities; no diagonal approximation, pseudoinverse, clipping, or regularization
projection.source_order: per atom Cartesian [q,px,py,pz], converted losslessly to raw MACE [q,y,z,x]

prospective_decision_rules.terminal_interpretation: pass permits source-only hybrid integration research; fail rejects this exact zero-training source/kernel candidate but does not authorize post-training until the remaining preregistered analytic charge-penetration route is also terminally tested
